visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven final portable views against four individually viewed local front, entrance and rear-corner originals. Seven-axis front, rounded corner, gray base, three-bay pediment, semicircular glazed canopy and taller rear mansard remain distinct. Review corrected inward side openings/dormers, curved-corner window occlusion, roof/lightwell gaps and ground masonry joints.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all seven final shared-material views including footprint overlay, plus full front/back views during correction. Stucco, limestone, slate, membrane, painted metal and bronze use shared metric surfaces; glass is local. Flat ground is a material fixture; the portable scene retains independent AHN terrain.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all nineteen final lighting, quality and forced-detail views. Skyline retains the massing, roof and pediment; district restores window rhythms and dormers; street/closeup add surrounds, entrance ribs and balustrades. Synthetic neighbors are style fixtures. No physical-device performance measurement is claimed.

geographicReview.notes: Mapped hotel footprint with canopy projection excluded from tall wall extrusion. Anchor [4.313317716121674,52.08384767340724], heading 0.6193741530923883: +X northeast along Lange Voorhout, +Z southeast toward the street. AHN4 DTM ground datum 2.6621 m NAP at [0,14]. Valid source pixels are preserved; masked building cells use explicitly recorded eight-sector inverse-distance interpolation, maximum nearest valid source distance about 15.9 m. This is inferred ground beneath the building, not a survey measurement. Source DSM roof returns control approximately 26 m roof height; map height 14 m is rejected as inconsistent. Foundation reaches -1.8 m; footprint suppression remains off.

fidelityReview.scope: Hotel des Indes exterior, front and long-side facades, rear wing, roof and entrance; interiors excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Four individually inspected Qualla originals and official municipal/hotel chronology control the facade and roof forms. AHN4 surface data refines total roof height and the upper lightwell; window/storey dimensions, hidden party walls, court faces, roof intersections and fine ornament remain approximations. Model uses original simplified relief; no photo pixels, exact crest or lettering copied.

runtimeLodReview.notes: All four current levels were visually inspected and pass budgets; exact triangle/byte counts are recorded in levels. Street windows use planar trim to preserve detail without exceeding its ceiling. Error values are authoring budgets, not measured deviations.

geometryValidation.notes: Exact regeneration, ordinary import verification, four current LOD checks and strict medium-fi audit passed. Source bundle, scene and terrain schemas pass; independent terrain PNG encoding error is recorded above. No independent Khronos-validator run is claimed.

limitations: Original medium-fi exterior based on individually inspected local front, entrance and rear-corner photographs; interiors excluded.
Mapped footprint and AHN4 surface heights control overall geometry; window/storey dimensions, upper court, roof joins and hidden elevations are estimates.
Simplified original relief and ornament; no copied photo textures, exact crest or lettering. Temporary flags, holiday decorations and crowds excluded.
AHN4 roof evidence dates to 2020–2022. Terrain ground beneath the building requires explicit gap interpolation; another host DEM can differ.

identityMigration.basis: Identity-only rename; exact source/runtime/LOD/heightfield/capture bytes verified unchanged. Existing visual inspection findings retained. No new capture or changed geometry is claimed.
